meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation, articles, or long-form content. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, articles, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting articles, or using "co-authoring" workflow.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 协作撰写文档、文章或长文内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人共同撰写结构化文档或文章。
copy.tagline_en: Co-author documentation, articles, or long-form content collaboratively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or articles with others.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成文档协作创作，包括收集背景信息、逐章节头脑风暴和撰写、以及检查文档是否清晰易懂。
howto.when: 当你提到写文档、提案、文章，或要求使用“co-authoring”工作流时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于AI工具的技术文档。
say.note: Claude 会开始收集文档类型、目标读者等信息。

say.text: 我们来co-authoring一篇小红书文章。
say.note: Claude 会进入协作创作流程。
Claude 会进入下一章节的头脑风暴和撰写。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through a structured co-authoring workflow for documentation, articles, or long-form content: gathering context, brainstorming and writing chapter by chapter, and optionally testing readability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention writing docs, proposals, articles, or using the "co-authoring" workflow.

say_en.text: Help me write a technical doc about AI tools.
say_en.note: Claude starts collecting document type, audience, etc.
Claude moves to brainstorming and writing the next chapter.
